about: Two lists the engine uses as vetoes (engine/veto.py) and nothing else. real_towns_replaced: real New Jersey municipalities inside Saint Jude's footprint (the northern Monmouth shore and bayshore, and the inner Monmouth and Middlesex country), which the bible says do not exist in this world (Part I 3.1a, Naming rule); the engine refuses them as a place where something is set or happens, and the Storyteller may borrow a name only by authoring a Saint Jude neighborhood of that name. Every entry is named in Part I 3.1a, which lists the whole replaced ground; real places beyond it, such as Perth Amboy, New Brunswick, Edison and Wall, exist as they are. Entries marked ambiguous are also ordinary words and match only with a place cue ('in Deal', 'Deal, NJ'). real_people: the real people the bible itself names as historical or offstage figures; 'No real person acts or speaks' (Index), so the engine refuses a new person or protagonist carrying one of these full names; Saint Jude stand-ins do that work. Real places the bible says exist (Newark, Elizabeth, Trenton, Atlantic City, Point Pleasant, Toms River) are not listed.
